title: Migrate feature-flag translation layer to canonical registry and remove legacy route-version adapters
creator: Priya Nair
description: Summary: Consolidate multiple translation helpers that map incoming request version/route labels to internal rollout keys into a single canonical registry. Replace per-service adapter logic used by legacy clients and eliminate the old route-version adapter layer. This reduces config lookup complexity, removes fragile dual-translation paths, and enables safer config rollouts and quicker config cache warmup.
acceptance_criteria: All active route-version adapters removed from runtime codebase and flagged as deprecated behind feature toggle
Canonical registry created and populated with migration mapping for 100% of currently active rollout keys
Unit and integration tests cover legacy client translation fallbacks for one release cycle
Monitoring dashboards show no increase in 5xx errors and latency delta < 2% during canary
Migration script completes within maintenance window and includes automated rollback path
comments: 2026-02-11 - Priya Nair: Kickoff: documented goals and preliminary mapping. Spotted 87 unique legacy route-version keys across services; planning to canonicalize to ~38 keys. Linked the registry design doc.
2026-02-18 - Diego Morales: Prototype complete. Created in-memory canonical registry and adapter shim. Benchmarked cold-start lookup: 12ms -> 5ms median. Attaching micro-benchmark results in the PR.

2026-02-25 - Ava Chen (PM): Reviewed approach. Concern about downstream consumers that still expect old key names. Suggested an opt-in compatibility window and a telemetry tag for translated requests.

2026-03-01 - Diego Morales: Added compatibility TTL flag and telemetry tag (header: X-RW-Compat). Began writing migration script that emits mapping audit report. Added end-to-end tests that simulate old and new clients.
2026-03-05 - Security review: Not required, but recommend adding audit logging for mapping decisions. Logged to config-audit stream.

2026-03-08 - QA: Found a race where registry hot-reload could temporarily return old mapping if concurrent deploys occur. Mitigation: deploy registry via atomic symlink and add a short freeze window for rollout changes. Created follow-up ENG-74155 for automated freeze enforcement.

2026-03-10 - Diego Morales: Canary started in us-west-2 with 2% traffic. No increase in error budget observed. Latency improved 1.8% for config-heavy routes. Preparing rollout plan to 25% on 2026-03-15.
2026-03-12 - Priya Nair: Reviewed canary metrics and approved expansion to 25% with rollback triggers defined. TODO: schedule ops page for migration execution and add runbook entry.
